reviewMethod: Assistant visual screening of 16 timestamped RGB frames per clip, plus five-frame overview; no continuous playback or human annotation
limitations: Provisional training labels only. Unseen brief events between sampled timestamps cannot be excluded.
Full-duration normal spans extrapolate beyond sampled instants. Selected partial spans omit later ambiguous physical contact.
Scene groups describe backgrounds, not independent actors or sessions. All recordings remain in the unresolved VID training cohort.
No identity, intent, injury or audio judgments. These are not independent evaluation ground truth.
